My dear Madam,
I send herewith a copy of [Heartsease leaves](/book/45), but I am afraid I must ask you to return it. I had some copies once sold for a bazaar, but they are all gone now, except one or two for home consumption of which I send one.
I am glad that the [Christian names](/book/48) gave you any amusement

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge
